# Bloub attribution

Source: https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub

Pinned commit: `b4bb3c1b5f93c7b87a2e8d620f667c4093d97749`

Imported: the framework-free `src/bot` modules required by `BotEngine`.
License: MIT, included in `LICENSE` and the packaged third-party notices.
FusionIsland's React adapter is separate. It restores the upstream palette, orbit gradients, particles and full viewBox.
The engine includes a stable-body policy for daily interactions; explicit previews retain original morphs.
It uses controlled application states and a visibility-aware clock rather than the upstream editor.
The application does not fetch the avatar or its code at runtime.
